thought_path_snapshot: First, consider sorting the array to easily identify the median, which could be a potential candidate for the target value after applying D.

The previous approach incorrectly assumed that using the median and checking differences against it would suffice to determine the minimum \( D \). This approach does not account for all possible ways to make all elements equal by adding or subtracting \( D \). The correct strategy should involve finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the differences between all pairs of elements, as this will give the smallest \( D \) that can make all elements equal.
